title: Follow-up: drop the child.exitCode ?? 0 fold from two new id-order tests after #605 and #606 merge
description: Opus reviewer finding m1 on the DEC-181 review of #605 and #606 (QCLI-497, OPAG-1441). test/draft-and-milestone-id-order.test.ts and test/milestone-stored-task-order.test.ts each define a local quest() helper that folds a null exit code with child.exitCode ?? 0, the pattern QCLI-502 removed from the whole test tree after the contributor approval base (see test/helpers/spawn.ts runCommand). It was not fixed in the maintainer conflict resolution because it is not a conflict line. Low practical risk: neither test reads the returned exit code and a killed child gives empty stdout, so JSON.parse throws.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Neither test file folds a null child exit code to 0; each uses the shared runCommand helper or an equivalent that fails on a null exit code.
